text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Countless spectators eager to see
Silence
Suzuka's overwhelming speed
flood the
racecourse for today's event.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what we're gonna see from
Suzuka
today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's even better than she was at
the
Mainichi Okan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Definitely! I don't even care if she wins
or loses, I
just wanna see her run again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Excitement runs through the crowd as
they wait
for the race to begin. In the
prep room, however,
the tension is
palpable.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's something we need to
talk about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She explains calmly, yet firmly that
there's a pain
in her leg, but she won't
let it take her out of the
race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...But I still want to run today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what the future holds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yet, we can overcome our limits. There's nothing to do but believe in that and just run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Will you trust me just one more time?
Just like
you did when we first started
working together?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, I'll come back
to you. I
promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can see the strength in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her I'll be waiting for her at the
finish line,
and she responds with a
bright smile.
